title: Aji Pasta
description: A unique and flavorful Indian-inspired pasta dish featuring aji peppers and umami sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat. Add sliced aji peppers and cook until tender.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan with the aji peppers and stir in umami sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with crunchy topping.
